prompts.title: Business Unit
prompts.description: Modify the business unit mapping for a dataset
prompts.template: I want to update the business unit for dataset '{dataset_name}'.

prompts.title: Email Alert
prompts.description: Configure email notifications for dataset alerts
prompts.template: I want to update the email alert configuration for dataset '{dataset_name}'. Set the alert email to '{email}'.

prompts.title: Dataset Definitions
prompts.template: I want to update the dataset definitions for '{dataset_name}'. Requirements: '{requirements}'.

prompts.title: LinkId
prompts.description: Update the LinkId mapping for a dataset
prompts.template: I want to update the linkId for dataset '{dataset_name}'. New linkId: '{new_linkid}'.

fields.name: new_linkid
fields.label: New LinkId
fields.placeholder: Use command separated text for new LinkId values (optional)

prompts.title: Data Domain Tagging
prompts.description: Assign or modify data domain tags
prompts.template: I want to update the data domain tagging for dataset '{dataset_name}'.

prompts.title: Sub-Domain Tagging
prompts.template: I want to update the sub-domain tagging for dataset '{dataset_name}'.

prompts.title: Create New S3 Dataset
prompts.description: Set up a new DQ dataset from S3 source
prompts.template: I want to create a new DQ dataset from S3. S3 path: '{s3_path}'. Market: '{market}'.

fields.name: market
fields.label: Market
fields.placeholder: e.g., JP, ANZ, KR, CN, REGION

prompts.title: Create New Redshift Dataset
prompts.description: Set up a new DQ dataset from Redshift table
prompts.template: I want to create a new DQ dataset from Redshift. Schema: '{schema}'. Table: '{table_name}'.

fields.name: schema
fields.label: Schema Name
fields.placeholder: e.g., jp, anz, cn, na, kr, pixonomy

prompts.title: Create DQ Custom Rule
prompts.description: Define a new custom data quality rule
prompts.template: I want to create a new DQ custom rule for dataset '{dataset_name}'. Rule description: '{rule_desc}'. SQL condition: '{rule_sql}'.

fields.name: rule_sql
fields.label: Rule SQL
fields.placeholder: Optional, e.g. SELECT * FROM @dataset_name WHERE condition

prompts.title: Update DQ Custom Rule
prompts.template: I want to update the custom rule '{rule_name}' for dataset '{dataset_name}'. Changes: '{rule_sql}'.

fields.name: rule_sql
fields.label: New Rule
fields.placeholder: Describe the changes or paste the new SQL here

prompts.title: Query JIRA Tickets
prompts.description: Search for and retrieve JIRA tickets
prompts.template: I want to query JIRA tickets with the following criteria: Project: '{project}'. Status: '{status}'. Search text: '{search_text}'.

fields.name: project
fields.label: JIRA Project
fields.placeholder: e.g., ANGen, iDiscover Regional MDM, iDiscover Data Quality

prompts.title: Submit DQ JIRA Ticket (New DQ Setup)
prompts.description: Create a new JIRA ticket for dataset setup
prompts.template: I want to submit a new DQ setup JIRA ticket. Project: '{project}'. Table name: '{table_name}'. Description: '{description}'. Data source: '{data_source}'.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.placeholder: Describe the new DQ setup request

prompts.title: Submit DQ JIRA Ticket (Change Request)
prompts.description: Create a JIRA ticket for dataset configuration changes
prompts.template: I want to submit a DQ change request JIRA ticket. Project: '{project}'. Dataset: '{dataset_name}'. Change type: '{change_type}'. Details: '{details}'.

fields.name: change_type
fields.label: Change Type
fields.placeholder: e.g., Add Rule, Update Domain, Modify Alert

prompts.title: Inspect DQ Findings
prompts.description: Review data quality findings for a dataset
prompts.template: I want to inspect the DQ findings for dataset '{dataset_name}'. Time period: '{time_period}'. Severity: '{severity}'.

prompts.title: Inspect DQ Configurations
prompts.template: I want to inspect the DQ configurations for dataset '{dataset_name}'.

prompts.title: DQ Best Practices
prompts.template: I want to know about DQ best practices, especially regarding: '{topic}'.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: Topic
fields.placeholder: Select a topic or enter custom question
